title: The stranger asks about the law

plan.english: Woman, what do the men of your village do to a thief? Whoever steals a goat, let him give three goats. And whoever carries off a pig, let him give two pigs. If he does not pay, what do they do? Then he works for the master of the goat. These are heavy words. Is the penalty greater among your people? Among us the thief pays twice.
